summary: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery found Bihar Government's BhuNaksha cadastral viewer and BiharBhumi land-record gateway. The current viewer HTML/JavaScript was inspected and anonymous hierarchy requests succeeded through Madhubani district and Jhanjharpur subdivision, but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, routes, statuses, configuration findings, and scratch evidence are recorded in city-11245-jhanjharpur.json.
